14:25.text: Giving its fruit at all times, by the Leave of its Lord, and Allâh sets forth parables for mankind in order that they may remember.

14:26.text: And the parable of an evil word is that of an evil tree uprooted from the surface of earth, having no stability.

14:27.text: Allâh will keep firm those who believe, with the word that stands firm in this world
(i.e. they will keep on worshipping Allâh Alone and none else)
And Allâh will cause to go astray those who are Zâlimûn
, and Allâh does what He wills.

14:28.text: Have you not seen those who have changed the Blessings of Allâh into disbelief
(by denying Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم and his Message of Islâm)
, and caused their people to dwell in the house of destruction?

14:29.text: Hell, in which they will burn, - and what an evil place to settle in!

14:30.text: And they set up rivals to Allâh, to mislead
! But certainly, your destination is the

14:31.text: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
who have believed, that they should perform As-Salât
, and spend in charity out of the sustenance We have given them, secretly and openly, before the coming of a Day on which there will be neither mutual bargaining nor befriending.

14:32.text: Allâh is He Who has created the heavens and the earth and sends down water
from the sky, and thereby brought forth fruits as provision for you; and He has made the ships to be of service to you, that they may sail through the sea by His Command; and He has made rivers
to be of service to you.

14:33.text: And He has made the sun and the moon, both constantly pursuing their courses, to be of service to you; and He has made the night and the day, to be of service to you.
